questions.q: For which values of k does x² + kx + 9 = 0 have equal roots?
questions.why: Equal roots need b² − 4ac = 0: k² − 36 = 0, so k = ±6.

questions.q: Write x² − 6x + 11 in completed-square form.
questions.why: x² − 6x = (x − 3)² − 9, so the expression is (x − 3)² + 2; the minimum point is (3, 2).

questions.q: Solve x² − 5x + 4 < 0.
questions.why: (x − 1)(x − 4) < 0 between the roots.

questions.q: f(x) = 2x + 3. What is f⁻¹(x)?
questions.why: Swap and rearrange: x = 2y + 3, so y = (x − 3)/2.

questions.q: f(x) = x² and g(x) = x + 1. What is fg(x)?
A function has an inverse only if it is…
questions.why: Each output must come from exactly one input.

questions.q: What is the centre and radius of (x − 2)² + (y + 1)² = 25?
questions.why: (x − a)² + (y − b)² = r² has centre (a, b) and radius r.

questions.q: What is the length of the line from (1, 2) to (4, 6)?
An arc of a circle of radius 6 cm subtends 0.5 radians. How long is the arc?
The area of a sector of radius 4 and angle 1.2 rad is…
Which identity is always true?
o: tan θ = cos θ / sin θ
questions.why: This is the fundamental Pythagorean identity.

questions.q: Solve sin x = 0.5 for 0° ≤ x ≤ 360°.
questions.why: Sine is positive in the first and second quadrants: 30° and 180° − 30°.

questions.q: What is the period of y = cos 2x?
questions.why: The period of cos kx is 360°/k.

questions.q: What is the coefficient of x² in (1 + 2x)⁵?
A geometric series has a = 8 and r = ½. What is its sum to infinity?
questions.why: S∞ = a/(1 − r) = 8 ÷ ½ = 16, valid because |r| < 1.

questions.q: The 10th term of the arithmetic progression 3, 7, 11, … is…
Differentiate y = 3x⁴ − 2x.
questions.why: d/dx(axⁿ) = naxⁿ⁻¹.

questions.q: At a stationary point, dy/dx equals…
questions.why: The gradient is zero; the second derivative tells maximum or minimum.

questions.q: Differentiate y = (2x + 1)³.
questions.why: Chain rule: 3(2x + 1)² × 2.

questions.q: Find ∫ 6x² dx.
questions.why: Raise the power by one and divide: 6x³/3 = 2x³.

questions.q: Evaluate ∫₀² 3x² dx.
questions.why: [x³]₀² = 8.

questions.q: Solve |x − 3| < 2.
What is the remainder when x³ − 2x + 1 is divided by (x − 2)?
questions.why: Remainder theorem: f(2) = 8 − 4 + 1 = 5.

questions.q: Solve eˣ = 5.
questions.why: Take natural logs of both sides.

questions.q: log 8 + log 2 equals…
questions.why: log a + log b = log(ab) = log 16.

questions.q: cos 2A can be written as…
questions.why: cos 2A = cos²A − sin²A = 1 − 2sin²A = 2cos²A − 1.

questions.q: sec θ is…
questions.why: sec = 1/cos, cosec = 1/sin, cot = 1/tan.

questions.q: Differentiate y = x eˣ.
questions.why: Product rule: eˣ + x eˣ.

questions.q: Differentiate y = ln(3x).
questions.why: ln(3x) = ln 3 + ln x, so the derivative is 1/x.

questions.q: Find ∫ 1/x dx (x > 0).
questions.why: The derivative of ln x is 1/x.

questions.q: Which method suits ∫ x cos x dx?
questions.why: u = x, dv = cos x dx gives x sin x + cos x + c.

questions.q: f(1) = −2 and f(2) = 3, with f continuous. What can you conclude?
questions.why: A change of sign shows a root in the interval.

questions.q: What is the scalar product of (1, 2, 3) and (4, −1, 0)?
Two non-zero vectors are perpendicular when their scalar product is…
The general solution of dy/dx = ky is…
questions.why: Separate variables: ∫dy/y = ∫k dx, ln y = kx + c.

questions.q: What is (2 + 3i)(1 − i)?
What is the modulus of 3 − 4i?
A 5 kg box on a smooth floor is pulled by a 20 N horizontal force. What is its acceleration?
Limiting friction is given by F = μR. What is R?
questions.why: R is the normal reaction; it equals the weight only on a horizontal surface with no other vertical forces.

questions.q: A particle moves with constant acceleration from rest to 12 m s⁻¹ in 4 s. How far does it go?
In how many ways can 5 different books be arranged on a shelf?
questions.why: Five choices for the first place, then four, three, two, one: 5! = 120.

questions.q: X ~ B(10, 0.3). What is E(X)?
X ~ N(50, 4²). What is P(X > 50)?
questions.why: The normal distribution is symmetric about its mean.

questions.q: Events A and B are independent when…
o: A and B can't both happen
questions.why: Mutually exclusive events are a different idea (P(A ∩ B) = 0).

questions.q: X ~ Po(4). What is Var(X)?
questions.why: For a Poisson distribution, mean = variance = λ.

questions.q: A Type I error is…
questions.why: Its probability equals the significance level (for continuous tests).
